passed: legacy read-only archive is restored without rewriting or recreating tokens
explicit range survives restart; failed range change retains saved token and scope
save, deduplicate, private permissions and no bookmark response
failed save/remove preserves previous archive and active entry
stale and denied bookmarks require reselect without deleting records
duplicate replacement and oversized bookmark preserve active entries
missing directory is unavailable and releases active scope
forget persists across reopen without deleting selected files
unknown or incomplete range formats fail closed and preserve archive
corrupt archive is retained and cannot be overwritten
symlink archive is refused without changing target
scope: production store with controlled OS scope adapter; not sandbox grant evidence
